gloss: in pieces; into fragments; smashed to bits

definitions.gloss: in pieces; into fragments; smashed to bits
definitions.explanation: Describes something being broken or shattered into many small pieces. Used both literally for physical objects and figuratively for things like dreams or hopes.

examples.japanese: ⟦コップ→コップ：00862_koppu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{粉々|こなごな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{割|わ}れた→割れる：00907_wareru⟧。
⟦{落|お}とした→落とす：01246_otosu⟧⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{粉々|こなごな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: The plate I dropped was smashed to bits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{粉々|こなごな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{打|う}ち{砕|くだ}かれた→打ち砕く：30356_uchikudaku⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I felt as though my long-held dream had been shattered to pieces.

notes:
USAGE: Almost always appears with the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ before a verb of breaking:
- {粉々|こなごな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{割|わ}れる→割れる：00907_wareru⟧ (to shatter into pieces)
- {粉々|こなごな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{砕|くだ}く→砕く：03920_kudaku⟧ (to crush to bits)
- {粉々|こなごな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to be smashed to pieces)

NA-ADJECTIVE USE: Less common, but possible before a noun:
- {粉々|こなごな}な⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (a shattered state)

FORMATION: A reduplication of ⟦{粉|こな}→粉：02766_kona⟧ (powder), emphasizing complete fragmentation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ばらばら→ばらばら：05165_barabara⟧ - scattered in pieces; suggests separation rather than shattering
- ⟦めちゃくちゃ→めちゃくちゃ：05178_mechakucha⟧ - wrecked, in a mess; broader destruction, often figurative
